findings.title: Error messages name the default folder's files on a CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR machine
findings.scoreReason: Correct (paths are hard-coded while the script now resolves CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR), but it only misleads wording in rare error messages and is a few-word fix better done now than tracked.

findings.title: HOOK reads CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR from the SSH session, against the new server standard
findings.scoreReason: Verified real defect on the owner's own CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR machine: HOOK reads the SSH session's variable, so a WorktreeCreate hook or plugin configured only in ~/.claude-twb is missed and the hub creates the worktree itself; the script already defines `t` and the test case already exists, so the fix is small.

findings.title: Modified Keychain requirement and HostSnapshot.config doc still name the default folder's paths
